source.title: What do you get from Prospecting Khaz'gorite Ore, WoW Dragonflight
source.author: Bue

notes: New 2022 first-person Khaz'gorite prospecting video identified, but its searchable description contains no exact number of ore, completed prospects or ranked output quantities. Inaccessible/undisclosed video-frame values are not inferred. Separately examined new Dragonflight crafted-item Wowhead pages 190486 and 193514; although related Disenchanting sections are indexed, per-material Looter denominators and numerators are not exposed in the accessible source text. Original Neoslayyer, Bugy, Aary, Jallfo and Khaz'gorite 100-R2-ore study families already exist in research and are excluded as repeat cohorts. Guide 5-herb/2–5-pigment quantity range is a reference, not a measured hit histogram. No independently new numerical operation ledger, 0-N histogram, castsWithDrop, refundable-input log, item-linked quality/output-rank measurement, or baseline eligibility established. No measured zero/probability/confidence inserted.
lookingFor: T0020/T0019/T0046/T0041: rank-specific Draconium Ore (189143/188658/190311), Serevite Ore (190395/190396/190394), Khaz'gorite Ore (190312/190313/190314), Prismatic Ore (194545) per-completed-prospect 0..N outputs including Illimited Diamond 192869/192870/192871, and T0018/T0015: Bubble Poppy 191467 and Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466 mill outputs Serene Pigment 198412/198413/198414 and Blazing Pigment 198418/198419/198420; seek independent completed-cast/refund histograms and gear disenchant samples.
